page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - Lead AWS Site Reliability Engineer
headline: Lead AWS Site Reliability Engineer | Cloud Architecture & Resiliency
summary_html: Lead AWS Site Reliability Engineer with 10+ years of cloud infrastructure, automation, production delivery, and troubleshooting experience. Combines senior engineering ownership with AWS resiliency, multi-region architecture, high availability, failover, and disaster recovery. Uses Terraform, CloudFormation (YAML), Python, and Linux to build repeatable infrastructure and maintain operational automation. AWS focus spans EC2, ECS, Lambda, Route 53, load balancers, SQS, S3, EFS, and RDS. Partners with application and platform teams on architecture reviews, incident diagnosis, observability, release safeguards, and recovery planning.

achievements.text: Aligns cloud infrastructure, application dependencies, and recovery planning for resilient AWS services.
Builds reusable infrastructure and Python automation to improve deployment consistency and reduce repetitive operational work.
Connects monitoring, incident troubleshooting, release validation, and recovery procedures across engineering teams.
